# Server Launch Checklist (Detailed)

*Generated by NOTIXNODE — Comprehensive pre-launch verification*

---

## Phase 1: Infrastructure (Week -2)

### Hardware / VPS
- [ ] CPU: [Cores/Threads] — [Benchmark score]
- [ ] RAM: [GB] DDR4/DDR5 — [Reserved for MC: GB]
- [ ] Storage: [NVMe/SSD] [GB] — [IOPS benchmark]
- [ ] Network: [Gbps] — [DDoS protection: Yes/No]
- [ ] OS: Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 LTS / Debian 12 / Rocky Linux 9
- [ ] Java: OpenJDK 21 (1.20.5+) / 17 (1.18-1.20.4) — Verified: `java -version`
- [ ] Swap: [Disabled / 4GB emergency]
- [ ] Timezone: UTC — `timedatectl set-timezone UTC`
- [ ] NTP: `systemctl enable systemd-timesyncd`

### Security
- [ ] SSH: Key-only, non-standard port, fail2ban
- [ ] Firewall: UFW/iptables — Only 22 (SSH), 25565 (MC), 25575 (RCON if used)
- [ ] User: `minecraft` (non-root, no sudo)
- [ ] Updates: `unattended-upgrades` configured
- [ ] Audit: `lynis` or `openscap` baseline scan

### Monitoring
- [ ] Node Exporter + Prometheus + Grafana
- [ ] Alerting: Discord webhook / PagerDuty
- [ ] Dashboards: JVM, System, Network, Disk

---

## Phase 2: Server Software (Week -1)

### Base Installation
- [ ] Software: Paper / Purpur / Spigot / Fabric / Forge / NeoForge / Velocity / Waterfall / Folia
- [ ] Version: [Exact build number]
- [ ] Download: Official site / CI (verified checksum)
- [ ] Directory: `/opt/minecraft/`
- [ ] Permissions: `chown -R minecraft:minecraft /opt/minecraft`

### JVM Flags (Aikar's + Custom)
```bash
# Example for 8GB heap on Paper 1.21.1
-Xms8G -Xmx8G \
-XX:+UseG1GC \
-XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled \
-XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 \
-XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions \
-XX:+DisableExplicitGC \
-XX:+AlwaysPreTouch \
-XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 \
-XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 \
-XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M \
-XX:G1ReservePercent=20 \
-XX:G1HeapWastePercent=5 \
-XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 \
-XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 \
-XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 \
-XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 \
-XX:SurvivorRatio=32 \
-XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem \
-XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 \
-Dusing.aikars.flags=https://mcflags.emilyx.dev \
-Daikars.new.flags=true \
-jar paper.jar --nogui
```
- [ ] Flags tested on staging
- [ ] GC logs enabled: `-Xlog:gc*:file=/opt/minecraft/logs/gc.log:time,uptime:filecount=5,filesize=10M`

### Configuration Files
- [ ] `server.properties` — Generated via NOTIXNODE Generator
- [ ] `paper.yml` — Optimized (entity activation ranges, hopper optimization, etc.)
- [ ] `spigot.yml` — Save structure, entity tracking
- [ ] `bukkit.yml` — Spawn limits, chunk GC
- [ ] `purpur.yml` / `folia.yml` — If applicable
- [ ] `velocity.toml` / `config.yml` (Waterfall) — If proxy
- [ ] All configs version-controlled (Git)

---

## Phase 4: World & Data (Days -3 to -1)

### World Setup
- [ ] World generated / imported
- [ ] Seed documented: `[seed]`
- [ ] Spawn built / imported
- [ ] Spawn protection: WorldGuard region (100-200 radius)
- [ ] Resource world(s) created (separate world, reset schedule)
- [ ] World border set: `/worldborder set [size]`
- [ ] Chunk pre-generation: `/chunky radius [size] && /chunky start` (if needed)

### Data Migration (If Existing Server)
- [ ] Player data exported
- [ ] Inventory/enderchest migrated
- [ ] Permissions migrated (LuckPerms export/import)
- [ ] Economy balances migrated
- [ ] Claims/regions migrated
- [ ] Statistics/achievements migrated

---

## Phase 5: Testing (Days -2 to Launch)

### Functional Testing
- [ ] Clean startup (no errors in console)
- [ ] Join as owner — `/gamemode creative`, `/fly`
- [ ] Test all commands (Essentials, LuckPerms, WorldEdit, etc.)
- [ ] Test permissions per group (default, member, donor, mod, admin)
- [ ] Test economy (balance, pay, shop, jobs)
- [ ] Test claims (create, trust, flags)
- [ ] Test DiscordSRV (chat sync, console, verification)
- [ ] Test CoreProtect (lookup, rollback)
- [ ] Test backup (manual trigger, verify files)
- [ ] Test anti-cheat (movement, combat, inventory)

### Load Testing
- [ ] Simulate [target] concurrent players (bots or staff)
- [ ] Monitor TPS (target: > 19.5)
- [ ] Monitor RAM (target: < 80% heap)
- [ ] Monitor CPU (target: < 70% single thread)
- [ ] Monitor disk I/O
- [ ] Monitor network (bandwidth per player)

### Stress Testing
- [ ] Chunk generation load (fly in new chunks)
- [ ] Entity stress (spawn mobs, test activation ranges)
- [ ] Redstone stress (large contraptions)
- [ ] Plugin command spam test

### Security Testing
- [ ] Attempt x-ray (verify anti-xray works)
- [ ] Attempt common exploits (logged)
- [ ] Verify RCON disabled or secured
- [ ] Verify query disabled or rate-limited
- [ ] Test ban/mute/kick/vanish

---

## Phase 6: Pre-Launch (Day -1)

### Final Preparations
- [ ] Final full backup
- [ ] Restart with fresh world (if new map)
- [ ] Verify all plugins load without errors
- [ ] Set `online-mode=true` (or false for cracked)
- [ ] Set `enforce-whitelist=false` (or true for private)
- [ ] Update Discord announcements
- [ ] Update website status page
- [ ] Staff briefing (schedule, commands, escalation)
- [ ] Emergency contacts verified

### DNS / Network
- [ ] A record: `play.yourserver.com` → Server IP
- [ ] SRV record (if non-standard port)
- [ ] Domain resolves correctly
- [ ] IPv6 AAAA record (if supported)
- [ ] DDoS protection enabled (Cloudflare Spectrum / TCPShield / provider)

---

## Phase 7: Launch (Day 0)

### Go Live
- [ ] Final server restart (00:00 UTC or planned time)
- [ ] Monitor console for 30 minutes
- [ ] First player joins — verify experience
- [ ] Post launch announcement (Discord, Twitter, website)
- [ ] Staff online for first 4 hours minimum

### First Hour Monitoring
- [ ] TPS stable
- [ ] No console errors
- [ ] Player count as expected
- [ ] Discord chat sync working
- [ ] No immediate exploits/bugs reported

### First 24 Hours
- [ ] Hourly TPS/RAM checks
- [ ] Review console for warnings
- [ ] Address player reports
- [ ] Hotfix any critical issues
- [ ] Backup after 24h uptime

---

## Phase 8: Post-Launch (Week 1)

- [ ] Daily backups verified
- [ ] Performance baseline established
- [ ] Player feedback collected
- [ ] Bug fixes deployed (scheduled restarts)
- [ ] Economy balanced
- [ ] Staff schedule active
- [ ] First event planned

---

## Rollback Plan

**If critical issue at launch:**
1. Stop server
2. Restore pre-launch backup
3. Communicate delay (Discord, website)
4. Fix issue on staging
5. Re-launch
